video.title: AI欧腐《被诅咒的人鱼王子/MY Cursed Merman Prince》
video.desc:
实不相瞒 我看见封面猫鱼进去的
Chubby merman prince Adrian wishes to be handsome and thin. As he gains admirers, he fears losing Cassian, so he wishes for Cassian to see only him. When sweet love turns to surveillance and possession, Adrian must give up magic-won love—while his cousin plots to steal the last wish.
胖乎乎的人鱼王子 Adrian 许下愿望，希望自己变得英俊又苗条。随着爱慕者越来越多，他却害怕失去 Cassian，于是又许愿让 Cassian 的眼中只有自己。当甜蜜的爱恋变成了监视与占有，Adrian 必须放弃这份靠魔法换来的爱情，而与此同时，他的表亲正密谋夺走最后一个愿望。
